title: Use Case Discovery & Prioritization
body: Discovery framework, high-leverage questions, the use case table, impact-vs-effort scoring, technical gotchas, and choosing hero use cases
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Use the outcomes > use cases > workflows > data > metrics framework.
Complete the use case table with impact and effort rationale.
Score and place use cases on the impact-vs-effort 2x2.
Identify technical gotchas that change effort or feasibility.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-105. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
